contract: A per-model lifetime split names a class only when the member spent in it: a class the member never spent is ABSENT, never a zero, and a member that spent nothing at all never reaches the wire. The producer (scripts/capture_usage_series.py, model_stats_section), the exporter's merge admission (scripts/export_usage_series.py, admit_model_stats), the origin (internal/panels/dataroot.go, orderModelStats) and the page (frontend/src/lib/token-usage.ts, admitClassTotals) each read THIS file in their tests, so the four cannot drift apart on the shape again (PR #312 review, finding 1). `admitted` shapes must be admitted by all four; `refused` shapes must be refused by all four.

admitted.name: one class only; the other three never spent

refused.name: a class outside the closed vocabulary
